title: Berlin Public Libraries - Quick Summary
items: **The VÖBB card costs 10 euros a year** and works in all of Berlin's roughly 80 public libraries. Students and trainees pay 5 euros, under-18s and Berlin-Pass holders pay nothing, and you can register online from 16.
**One card covers far more than books:** eBooks and audiobooks through the Onleihe, international newspapers through PressReader, and the filmfriend streaming service, all from home.

**Sundays stopped being closed doors.** The Amerika-Gedenkbibliothek opens Sundays 11:00 to 17:00, and district libraries in Friedrichshain, Pankow, Charlottenburg, Wilmersdorf, Spandau, Tempelhof, Köpenick and Lichtenberg now open Sundays too, mostly in self-service mode.

**The Staatsbibliothek card is free since the fee was dropped**, and both houses run Monday to Saturday 8:00 to 22:00 plus Sunday 10:00 to 18:00. For long, quiet work days it is the strongest free desk in the city.
**Every door on the board closes on public holidays.** The digital side of the card keeps working, which matters most exactly on those days.
